correctness.rationale: Exact group enumeration yields A4 and C12 of order 12 with trivial intersection. Their trace functions yield the printed numerator polynomials and a birational basepoint-free degree-12 morphism. A standalone, dependency-free exhaustive calculation over F121 verifies 25 double, 6 triple and 2 quadruple repeated-image fibers with all branch tangents distinct. The sum of local delta invariants is 25+6*3+2*6=55, equal to the arithmetic genus of the degree-12 rational plane curve. The genus-delta equality forces geometric completeness over the entire algebraic closure; finite sampling alone is not used as an infinite proof. All claimed rationality and Frobenius counts follow from exact F121 images.

value.rationale: The exact singularity basket and rationality spectrum answer a motivated local-geometry question for a published extremal positive-characteristic Galois-point construction. The 25/6/2 profile, including four different ordinary multiplicity-four branches and complete genus-bound saturation, is mathematically substantive and not a routine rephrasing of the known group-pair existence result. Determination of five F11-rational singular nodes and the total nine F11-rational curve points supplies useful arithmetic geometry of the same explicitly defined model.
